body:
GitHub issue #372, follow-up to #359 / PR #362. Four independent defects in the `off-by-one` tuning-constant mask (`packages/core/lib/mutate.mjs`) and the mutation-gate failure message. All four reproduce on `main` at 07b49f78.

## Reproduction (verified)

    node -e "import('./packages/core/lib/mutate.mjs').then(({OPERATORS})=>{const o=OPERATORS.find(x=>x.name==='off-by-one');console.log(o.apply('const MAX_BUFFER_BYTES = 512 * 1024 * 1024;'))})"

yields `513 * 1024 * 1024` (mutated) while the same constant named `MAX_BUFFER` yields `null` (masked).

## Defect 1 — the mask misses any key with an adjacent identifier segment

`TUNING_ASSIGNMENT_RE` is `\b(?:KEYS)\s*[:=]\s*(VALUE)`. The `\b` forbids a LEADING segment and the immediate separator forbids a TRAILING one, so both idiomatic spellings escape the mask:

- trailing: `MAX_BUFFER_BYTES`, `maxBufferBytes` (key matches, `_BYTES` blocks the separator)
- leading: `GIT_TIMEOUT_MS`, `gitTimeoutMs` (no `\b` between `_`/lowercase and the key)

`*_BYTES` and `*_MS` name the unit, which is the clearer name. #363 had to rename `MAX_BUFFER_BYTES` to `MAX_BUFFER` purely to get the gate green.

Widening the key match is the direction that DELETES real prosecution, so the fix must not turn `MAX_RETRIES` or `LIMIT` into masked keys.

## Defect 2 — `chunk_size` and `buffer_size` are COUNTS

The operator's own comment states counts stay mutable because `+1` on a count is observable. `chunkSize` counts elements: a test can assert `chunk(items,{chunkSize:100})[0].length === 100`. Both keys are nevertheless in `TUNING_KEYS`, so that boundary is silently unprosecuted. This is the over-suppression direction.

## Defect 3 — the disclosed KNOWN LIMIT understates the gap

Two ordinary ASSIGNMENT forms are still mutated despite the comment reading as "assignments are handled, call args are not":

    const o = { "timeout": 60000 };        -> 60001   (quoted property key)
    const o = { timeout: /* ms */ 60000 }; -> 60001   (inline unit comment)

## Defect 4 — `scripts/mutation-gate.mjs` asserts something the code contradicts

The failure message says "There is NO comment or annotation that suppresses this gate". `SKIP_LINE` in `mutate.mjs` skips any line beginning with `/*`, so `/* x */ const limit = 3;` yields zero mutants while `const limit = 3;` yields one. A one-line prefix comment is a working bypass, and the message tells authors to stop looking for it.

## Acceptance criteria

1. `MAX_BUFFER_BYTES`, `maxBufferBytes`, `GIT_TIMEOUT_MS`, `gitTimeoutMs`, and `TTL_MS` are MASKED (operator returns null).
   Verify: `node --test packages/core/test/core.test.mjs` — new cases asserting `offByOne().apply(...) === null` for each spelling.
2. `MAX_RETRIES`, `LIMIT`, `maxRetries`, `retryLimit`, and `timeoutRetries` still MUTATE.
   Verify: same test file — assertions that each returns the +1 line, including at least one name that CONTAINS a tuning key but denotes a count.
3. `chunkSize` and `bufferSize` mutate again, with a test that asserts the observable count boundary they guard (a chunking helper whose batch length changes when the constant does), not a source-text pin.
   Verify: `node --test packages/core/test/core.test.mjs`.
4. `{ "timeout": 60000 }` is masked (quoted property key), and a value separated from its key by an inline `/* ... */` comment is masked.
   Verify: `node --test packages/core/test/core.test.mjs`.
5. BOTH halves of defect 4 are closed, not one: (a) `SKIP_LINE` recognises a CLOSED `/* ... */` prefix followed by code, so `/* x */ const limit = 3;` yields a mutant while a genuine block-comment opener (`/* start of a multi-line comment`) is still skipped; and (b) `scripts/mutation-gate.mjs`'s message states the accurate claim (no SUPPORTED suppression) instead of the false absolute. Doing only (a) leaves a message that will drift false again; doing only (b) documents a live bypass instead of closing it.
   Verify: `node --test packages/core/test/core.test.mjs` for (a) including the still-skipped opener case, and `node --test scripts/test/` for (b).
6. No regression in the existing #359 mask behaviour: zero values, negative sentinels, whole-expression masking, and same-line real boundaries all keep their current outcomes.
   Verify: the pre-existing off-by-one tests in `packages/core/test/core.test.mjs` pass unchanged.
7. A PROPERTY test generates identifier spellings and asserts the mask decision is a function of the identifier's SEGMENTS, so the next spelling variant does not need another enumerated case (lesson: rail predicates need a property test).
   Verify: `node --test packages/core/test/core.test.mjs`.

## Tier

`packages/core` is a frozen rail (declared by completed T42/T43/T44) and an enforcement package, so this is trust-root tier: the P5 gate requires a cross-model `cross-model-review` approve from a provider distinct from the author, and the commit needs `ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS=1` (maintainer-approved 2026-08-19).
title: Repair the off-by-one tuning mask: prefixed/suffixed keys, count over-suppression, quoted keys, and the gate's false suppression claim (#372)
